# Home Clarity Report

> The Home Clarity Report is a $4,500 home advisory service delivered in 5 business days by Adam Kilgore, a 27-year Summit County, Ohio remodeling expert. It provides Northeast Ohio homeowners with a complete picture of their home — every room measured, every system scored, every project scoped and priced — by someone with no financial stake in what they choose.

## What It Is

The Home Clarity Report is not a home inspection. It is a comprehensive home advisory service that gives homeowners the information, strategy, and expert relationship they need to make confident decisions about their property.

The core conflict of interest in home services: contractors who advise homeowners also profit from what those homeowners decide to do. The Home Clarity Report eliminates that conflict entirely. Adam Kilgore never bids on the work he assesses.

## What's Included ($4,500)

- 30 to 50 page written report covering every room and system
- Architect-grade interior floor plans accurate to 1/8 inch
- Full 3D exterior model via Hover technology
- Immersive 360° interior photo tour via Matterport
- Proactive replacement pricing for every major system
- Complete owner's manuals for every appliance and mechanical system
- Detailed written scopes of work for every project discussed
- Lifetime access to private Home OS dashboard
- AI home assistant (Bobby) trained on your specific property
- Direct message line to Adam
- Permanent advisory relationship — one expert for the life of your home

## Service Area

Primary: Summit County, Ohio — Hudson, Bath Township, Fairlawn, Richfield, Cuyahoga Falls, Stow, Copley, Silver Lake, Peninsula, Tallmadge, Montrose-Ghent, Munroe Falls, Twinsburg  
Adjacent: Medina County, Portage County, northern Stark County, southern Cuyahoga County

## Pricing

$4,500 flat fee. Delivered in 5 business days. No upsells. No contractor relationships that create conflicts of interest.
